title: 2022 CODATA: vacuum mag. permeability is 1.256 637 061 27 × 10^−6
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives vacuum mag.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives vacuum mag. permeability as 1.256 637 061 27 × 10^−6 N A^-2, with uncertainty 0.000 000 000 20 × 10^−6 N A^-2. The row is not marked exact. The 2022 listing gives the vacuum magnetic permeability with an uncertainty and does not mark it exact.
